aka.en: Jiangsu Coastal High-Grade Highway (the Jiangsu section)
aka.zh: 江苏临海高等级公路（江苏段）

tagline.en: The mainland's coast from the Yalu to the Vietnamese border, still being joined up across its bays
tagline.zh: 沿大陆海岸线从鸭绿江到中越边境，跨海湾的断点仍在逐一接通

start.en: Zhushan village, Dongxing, Guangxi, on the Vietnamese border; Chinese Wikipedia puts the end at the Luofu roundabout on the coastal road in Dongxing
start.zh: 广西东兴市中越边境竹山村；中文维基百科记终点为东兴市滨海公路罗浮转盘

end.en: Rongcheng, at the eastern tip of the Shandong peninsula, where the drawn line ends. The route's northern terminus is at Hushantou village, Kuandian county, Dandong, Liaoning, on the Yalu; the atlas draws the section from Shandong's north coast to Dandong separately
end.zh: 山东半岛东端荣成，所绘线段止于此。路线北端在辽宁丹东宽甸县虎山镇虎山头村，鸭绿江畔；自山东北部沿海至丹东的路段在图集中另行绘出

en: G228 is the coastal national highway. The national highway plan of June 2013 runs it from Dandong on the North Korean border to Dongxing on the Vietnamese border, and its control points follow the mainland coast almost town by town: Dalian, Yingkou and Huludao in Liaoning; Qinhuangdao, Tianjin's Binhai New Area and Huanghua port; Binzhou port, Dongying port, Yantai, Weihai, Rongcheng, Qingdao and Rizhao in Shandong; Lianyungang and the Jiangsu coast to Haimen and Chongming; Shanghai; Ningbo, Taizhou and the Zhejiang coast; Ningde, Fuzhou, Quanzhou and Xiamen in Fujian; Shantou, Shenzhen, Zhongshan, Zhuhai, Yangjiang and Zhanjiang in Guangdong; and Beihai and Fangchenggang in Guangxi. Most of the coast's ports lie on it.

With G331 along the northern border and G219 down the west, it closes a ring round the country. Its length depends on the source: Chinese Wikipedia gives 6,916.056 km on the ground and a planned 7,800 km; a 2026 Ministry of Transport briefing gives about 7,400 km.

The atlas draws G228 in two pieces. This profile is attached to the longer, which runs from Dongxing along the Guangxi, Guangdong, Fujian, Zhejiang, Shanghai and Jiangsu coasts to the eastern tip of the Shandong peninsula. The second piece, drawn separately, runs from the northern Shandong coast through Hebei and Tianjin and round Liaoning to Dandong.
zh: G228 是沿海国道。按 2013 年 6 月的《国家公路网规划》，它自中朝边境的丹东至中越边境的东兴，主要控制点几乎逐城沿大陆海岸线排列：辽宁大连、营口、葫芦岛；秦皇岛、天津滨海新区、黄骅港；山东滨州港、东营港、烟台、威海、荣成、青岛、日照；江苏连云港及沿海至海门、崇明；上海；浙江宁波、台州及沿海；福建宁德、福州、泉州、厦门；广东汕头、深圳、中山、珠海、阳江、湛江；广西北海、防城港。沿海主要港口大都在这条线上。
它与沿北部边境的 G331、沿西部边境的 G219 一起，构成环绕国土的一圈。里程因来源而异：中文维基百科给出实际里程 6916.056 公里、规划长度 7800 公里；2026 年交通运输部的介绍为约 7400 公里。
本图集把 G228 分成两段绘制。本条目挂在较长的一段上：自东兴起，沿广西、广东、福建、浙江、上海、江苏海岸至山东半岛东端。另一段另行绘出，自山东北部沿海经河北、天津，绕辽宁海岸至丹东。

en: A coast road meets estuaries and bays, and G228's large works are mostly bridges. At Wenzhou it crosses the mouth of the Ou river on the lower deck of the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge, a double-deck suspension bridge with three towers and four spans: the Ningbo–Dongguan Expressway runs on top and G228 below, six lanes at 80 km/h, over a 2,090 m main bridge. In Guangxi the Longmen Bridge, 7.637 km long with a 1,098 m suspension span, crosses the Maowei Sea and the mouth of the Pinglu Canal as a six-lane class-I road for 100 km/h; it is the longest sea bridge in Guangxi.

In Jiangsu the road was built new as a 530 km class-I road, mostly four lanes at 100 km/h. According to Baidu Baike, its Yancheng section, 241 km, passes for 70 km through the national nature reserves for the red-crowned crane and Père David's deer, and its last link, the Guanjiangkou Bridge between Lianyungang and Yancheng, is 7.644 km long with a 400 m cable-stayed main span. In Shandong, the Binzhou section's Taoer River bridge was designed with a 338 m main span of mixed girders in continuous rigid frame, which the local press said would be the longest of its type in the world.

Elsewhere G228 is stitched together from existing roads. In Shenzhen and Dongguan it shares the road with G107, and after a 2026 reorganisation of Guangdong's network it uses the Huizhou–Shenzhen coastal expressway and crosses the Pearl River on the Humen Bridge. Chinese Wikipedia notes that in western Guangdong it does not run down the Leizhou peninsula as the plan intended.
zh: 海岸公路要过河口和海湾，G228 的大工程多是桥。在温州，它经瓯江北口大桥下层过瓯江：这是一座三塔四跨双层钢桁梁悬索桥，上层为甬莞高速，下层为 G228，双向六车道，设计时速 80 公里，跨江主桥长 2090 米。在广西，龙门大桥全长 7.637 公里，主航道桥为跨径 1098 米的悬索桥，跨越茅尾海和平陆运河出海口，按双向六车道一级公路、设计时速 100 公里建设，是广西最长的跨海大桥。
江苏段是新建的 530 公里一级公路，以双向四车道、设计时速 100 公里为主。据百度百科，盐城段 241 公里，其中经过丹顶鹤和麋鹿两个国家级自然保护区的路段共 70 公里；最后贯通的连云港与盐城交界处灌江口大桥全长 7.644 公里，主桥为跨径 400 米的斜拉桥。山东滨州段的套尔河大桥，主桥设计为主跨 338 米的混合梁连续刚构桥，当地媒体称建成后将是该结构形式跨径世界第一的梁桥。
其余路段多由既有道路连缀而成。在深圳、东莞，它与 G107 共线；2026 年广东路网调整后，它走惠深沿海高速，并经虎门大桥过珠江。中文维基百科指出，粤西段并未如规划那样经过雷州半岛。

en: Several provinces built coastal roads before the number existed. Liaoning began its coastal road in 2006, with the Dalian section due to start in April; the 1,443 km road, from the Hushan Great Wall in Dandong — where G228 now begins — to Suizhong, opened on 27 September 2009, and Xinhua called it China's longest coastal road. Jiangsu started its 530 km coastal high-grade highway on 1 June 2010; the Nantong and Yancheng sections opened at the end of 2013, Lianyungang at the end of 2014, and the whole road on 8 July 2015 with the Guanjiangkou Bridge.

The national highway plan of June 2013 added coastal and border routes to the network and gave the coast one number, G228. Provinces then filled the gaps. Fuqing in Fujian began its coastal corridor on 30 December 2014; Guangdong issued a plan for a 1,875 km coastal tourist highway in March 2018, and a 2024 local report says its main line in Yangjiang is on the G228 alignment. Binzhou in Shandong began a PPP project on 31 December 2019. The Oujiang North Estuary Bridge opened in 2022, its G228 deck on 31 August, and Guangxi's Longmen Bridge on 29 December 2024.

G228 is still not continuous. In August 2026 Fujian had 232 km of its 1,250 km section still to be joined up, due in 2029. In Guangxi the Dafengjiang–Gaode section near Beihai was found to cross habitat of the critically endangered spoon-billed sandpiper; after a central environmental inspection team took up public complaints, the Guangxi environment department ordered on 25 May 2026 that work stop and the route be reconsidered. The Ministry of Transport has said the coastal road will be completed through, broadly to class-II standard or better, in 2026–2030.
zh: 这个编号出现以前，沿海几个省已在修滨海公路。辽宁滨海公路于 2006 年启动，大连段计划当年 4 月开工；这条全长 1443 公里的公路东起丹东虎山长城——今天 G228 的起点所在——西至绥中，于 2009 年 9 月 27 日全线竣工通车，新华社称其为中国里程最长的滨海公路。江苏临海高等级公路全长 530 公里，2010 年 6 月 1 日开工；南通段、盐城段 2013 年底建成通车，连云港段 2014 年底通车，2015 年 7 月 8 日随灌江口大桥通车全线贯通。

2013 年 6 月的《国家公路网规划》增设沿边沿海路线，把整条海岸线编为一个号：G228。此后各省补齐缺口。福建福清滨海大通道一期于 2014 年 12 月 30 日动工；广东于 2018 年 3 月印发全长 1875 公里的《广东滨海旅游公路规划》，据 2024 年当地报道，其阳江段主线纳入 G228 线位；山东滨州段 PPP 项目于 2019 年 12 月 31 日启动。瓯江北口大桥 2022 年通车，下层 G228 于 8 月 31 日通行；广西龙门大桥 2024 年 12 月 29 日通车。

G228 至今尚未全线贯通。2026 年 8 月，福建段全长 1250 公里中仍有 232 公里待贯通，预计 2029 年全线贯通。广西北海附近的大风江至高德段被发现穿越极危物种勺嘴鹬的重要栖息地；中央生态环境保护督察组受理群众举报后，广西壮族自治区生态环境厅于 2026 年 5 月 25 日要求暂停工程建设、开展选址选线论证。交通运输部表示，“十五五”（2026—2030 年）期间沿海国道 G228 将全面贯通，基本达到二级及以上标准。

en: No cost exists for G228 as a whole; each province paid for its own coastal road, and the figures are not comparable in scope. Liaoning's 1,443 km coastal road was reported at more than 13 billion yuan, against an estimate of 13.3 billion funded by provincial subsidy and local money; Jiangsu's 530 km road cost 18.2 billion yuan, the most for any road in the province's history. Bridges cost far more per kilometre: the 7.637 km Longmen Bridge 5.71 billion yuan, invested by the Guangxi Communications Investment Group and tolled. Fuqing's 114.7 km coastal corridor was put at about 12.575 billion yuan.
The Ministry of Transport put the cost of finishing and upgrading the whole ring of G219, G331 and G228 — about 7,400 km of building and rebuilding in 2026–2030 — at about 370 billion yuan.
zh: G228 没有全线总造价；各省区分别出资修建本省滨海公路，数字的口径也不可比。辽宁滨海公路 1443 公里，据报道总投资 130 多亿元，估算总投资 133 亿元，采用省补贴和地方自筹；江苏临海高等级公路 530 公里，总投资 182 亿元，为江苏公路史之最。桥梁每公里造价要高得多：7.637 公里的龙门大桥总投资 57.1 亿元，由广西交通投资集团投资建设，收费通行。福清滨海大通道全长约 114.7 公里，总投资约 125.75 亿元。
交通运输部估计，“十五五”期间贯通并提升 G219、G331、G228 整个环线，建设改造里程约 7400 公里，总投资约 3700 亿元。

en: G228 is free where it is an ordinary national road, but some new crossings are tolled: the Longmen Bridge in Guangxi charges a toll, while the G228 deck of the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge is free and closed to vehicles carrying hazardous chemicals, pedestrians and non-motorised traffic. Jiangsu's 530 km section has no toll stations.
Because the road is still in pieces in Fujian and Guangxi, and runs on city streets and expressways through the Pearl River Delta, the route does not yet run as one continuous coast road.
zh: G228 作为普通国道一般免费通行，但部分新建跨海通道收费：广西龙门大桥收取车辆通行费；瓯江北口大桥下层 G228 免费通行，但禁止危化品运输车辆、行人和非机动车通行。江苏段 530 公里不设收费站。
由于福建、广西仍有断点，珠三角一带又走城市道路和高速公路，G228 目前还不是一条连续的沿海公路。

why.en: No route-wide cost exists. G228 is made up of provincial coastal roads built and rebuilt from 2006 onwards and is not yet complete; sourced provincial and project figures are listed below.
why.zh: 不存在全线总造价。G228 由 2006 年以来各省区分别修建、改建的滨海公路组成，至今尚未全线贯通；已查到来源的省级和项目数字分列于下。

value.en: Provincial and local, project by project. Liaoning: provincial subsidy plus local funds. Binzhou, Shandong: a PPP project. Longmen Bridge, Guangxi: invested by the Guangxi Communications Investment Group and tolled. Oujiang North Estuary Bridge: Ministry of Transport subsidy plus the owner's own funds. No route-wide statement exists.
value.zh: 按项目由省区和地方出资。辽宁：省补贴和地方自筹；山东滨州段：PPP 项目；广西龙门大桥：广西交通投资集团投资建设，收费通行；瓯江北口大桥：交通运输部补助与自筹。未见全线出资说明。

timeline.en: Liaoning begins its 1,443 km coastal road, starting with the Dalian section.
timeline.zh: 辽宁滨海公路启动建设，大连段率先开工。

timeline.en: The Liaoning Coastal Road, from the Hushan Great Wall to Suizhong, opens on 27 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 27 日，东起虎山长城、西至绥中的辽宁滨海公路全线竣工通车。

timeline.en: Work starts on Jiangsu's 530 km coastal highway on 1 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 1 日，江苏临海高等级公路开工。

timeline.en: The national highway plan of June creates G228, Dandong to Dongxing, along the coast.
timeline.zh: 6 月，《国家公路网规划》增设沿海路线 G228 丹东至东兴。

timeline.en: The Guanjiangkou Bridge opens on 8 July, completing the Jiangsu section.
timeline.zh: 7 月 8 日，灌江口大桥通车，江苏段全线贯通。

timeline.en: Guangdong issues its plan for a 1,875 km coastal tourist highway in March.
timeline.zh: 3 月，广东印发全长 1875 公里的《广东滨海旅游公路规划》。

timeline.en: Binzhou starts its G228 PPP project on 31 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，G228 滨州段 PPP 项目启动建设。

timeline.en: Work starts on the Longmen Bridge in Guangxi on 31 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 31 日，广西龙门大桥动工。

timeline.en: G228 opens on the lower deck of the Oujiang North Estuary Bridge on 31 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 31 日，瓯江北口大桥下层 G228 通行。

timeline.en: The Longmen Bridge, the longest sea bridge in Guangxi, opens on 29 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 29 日，广西最长跨海大桥龙门大桥通车。

timeline.en: Guangxi orders work on the Dafengjiang–Gaode section stopped on 25 May to protect spoon-billed sandpiper habitat.
timeline.zh: 5 月 25 日，广西要求大风江至高德段暂停建设，以保护勺嘴鹬栖息地。
